files.help:
XDG is supported out-of-the-box by libxkbcommon, so you can simply move the file to _$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/XCompose_.

This covers programs that compose through libxkbcommon, e.g. the input method daemon **fcitx5** and Qt applications.

libX11 (XIM) only knows _$HOME/.XCompose_. For X11 programs that compose without an input method, export the following environment variable:

```bash
export XCOMPOSEFILE="$XDG_CONFIG_HOME"/XCompose
```

_Note:_ the file is read once, when a program starts. Input method daemons such as fcitx5 start with the graphical session and never see variables set in your shell's rc file; set _XCOMPOSEFILE_ in the session environment instead (e.g. _$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/environment.d/_), and log out and back in after moving the file.

Export the following environment variables:

```bash
export XCOMPOSECACHE="$XDG_CACHE_HOME"/X11/xcompose
```
